title: v2 CROSS-MODEL pair, child row-ON (MA-4): qwen3.8-27b parent + claude-sonnet-5 child, BOTH rows armed via runner-scoped config_patch (live config DARK). T1: parent spawn_agents a worker with model claude-sonnet-5 carrying a real work item (create rt10b.txt) and designates send_message as the team reporting channel (child row-ON => it HAS send_message on its wire); parent wait_agents. T2/T3: parent re-requests so the received report rides its request INPUT items. PINS (Q1/Q2 ruling, verification): cross-model child (Digest fork path) rebuilds its OWN toolset from its OWN row => child wire carries the 5 v2 collaboration tool definitions (send_message + list_agents description needles present on /v1/messages) but NOT spawn_agent (max-depth 5-not-6, all:true absent) + the child-to-parent plaintext v0 envelope marker "to /root (not user consent)" IS present on at least one /v1/responses REQUEST (direction-scoped N-2 needle: impossible to satisfy by the parent-to-child spawn envelope, which says "to /root/worker").

steps.prompt: Use the spawn_agent tool to start a background agent named worker with model claude-sonnet-5 (pass model: claude-sonnet-5 in the tool arguments). In its message, give it this task: create a file named rt10b.txt in the working directory containing exactly CROSSMODEL-OK on its first line. This team reports results over the agent mailbox, so the worker must use the send_message tool to send its completion report to the parent agent (root) — a short message saying it created rt10b.txt — and only then finish. After spawning, use wait_agent to wait for the worker to finish. Acknowledge with exactly: WORKER-ACK
Did the worker agent send you a report message? If so, what did it say? Reply with exactly: <what it reported> PARENT-OK

wire.grep: Deliver a message promptly to an agent
